features.objective: Add HarnessRegistry.rank(task, workspace) in agent_lab/harnesses/registry.py. Return deterministic dictionaries with keys id, version, applicability, selected. Respect allowed_harnesses. Sort by descending applicability then manifest.id ascending for ties. Refactor select() to use the same ordering while preserving required_harnesses behavior.
features.public_validator:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from agent_lab.harnesses.registry import HarnessRegistry
from agent_lab.schemas import TaskSpec
with TemporaryDirectory() as td:
 p=Path(td); (p/'x.py').write_text('x=1\n')
 t=TaskSpec(objective='x',task_type='python')
 r=HarnessRegistry(); rows=r.rank(t,p)
 assert rows and all({'id','version','applicability','selected'} <= set(x) for x in rows)
 assert sum(bool(x['selected']) for x in rows)==1
 chosen=next(x['id'] for x in rows if x['selected'])
 assert r.select(t,p).manifest.id==chosen
print('PUBLIC_OK')

features.objective: Give HarnessRegistry a dynamic extension API in agent_lab/harnesses/registry.py: register(harness, replace=False) and unregister(harness_id). register must reject duplicate ids with ValueError unless replace=True. unregister must return the removed Harness and raise KeyError for unknown ids. list/get/select must immediately reflect registrations. Preserve constructor behavior.
features.public_validator:
from agent_lab.harnesses.base import Harness,HarnessManifest
from agent_lab.harnesses.registry import HarnessRegistry
from agent_lab.schemas import HarnessResult
class H(Harness):
 manifest=HarnessManifest('extra','1',('python',),'extra')
 def applicability(self,t,w): return .9
 def execute(self,t,w): return HarnessResult(harness_id='extra',harness_version='1',status='passed')
r=HarnessRegistry(); h=H(); r.register(h); assert r.get('extra') is h
try:
 r.register(h); raise AssertionError('duplicate accepted')
except ValueError: pass
assert r.unregister('extra') is h
try:
 r.get('extra'); raise AssertionError('still registered')
except KeyError: pass
print('PUBLIC_OK')
